One design rule we break on purpose ✦

"Never use more than two typefaces." Our own logo uses three: a cursive serif for warmth, a condensed sans for punch and a clean sans for everything else.

Rules are a starting point. A clear brand system is what makes breaking them look intentional.

How to brief a designer (and get what you actually want) 📝

A good design brief saves weeks of back and forth. Start with the why, name your audience, share references you love and hate, list your must-haves and agree on what success looks like.
